mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees and clear at Fireman's Park. Tonight features a waxing gibbous moon and a treat for space fans, as the ISS will be visible at 4:11 AM, traveling from over Cross Plains toward Madison near Home Depot. Expect an overnight low of 65 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has officially started an eighteen-month process to update the 2026 Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term guide for local growth and zoning. A task force has been appointed to oversee this, and citizens are encouraged to visit the Envision Verona website to participate in public engagement opportunities.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, grab pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or test your brain at the Bogey Factory trivia night.
Regarding recent activity, on August 23, police officers conducted a stop that resulted in citations for absolute sobriety and underage drinking for two young men from Madison.

Today's flavor is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. Since the store is currently closed, be sure to head over when they open at 10 AM tomorrow to enjoy a scoop. Tomorrow's featured flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
